entries.sourceNotes: Universal Postal Union, official history: Treaty of Bern 1874; agreement with the UN in force 1 July 1948.

factCards.text: The Charter of the United Nations was signed in San Francisco on 26 June 1945 and entered into force on 24 October 1945, now marked as United Nations Day.
factCards.sourceTitle: United Nations — Charter of the United Nations

factCards.text: The Universal Postal Union was created by the Treaty of Bern in 1874 and became a specialized agency of the United Nations in 1948, which makes it one of the oldest international organisations still in operation.
factCards.sourceTitle: Universal Postal Union — About the UPU

factCards.text: As of 2026 the United Nations counts 193 Member States; the most recent admission was South Sudan in July 2011. Membership figures should be re-checked against the official list, which changes only by admission.
